summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Cresud S.A., an Argentine real estate and agricultural company, reporting the upcoming payment of the first interest installment on its Series L fixed-rate notes. The payment of USD 3,830,466.12 (7.25% annual rate on USD 70,381,079 outstanding principal) will occur on September 10, 2026, via Caja de Valores S.A. for noteholders of record on September 9, 2026. This is a standard debt-service notice, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved; it is simply a scheduled interest payment.
